resources.string: Get a quick view of GestureEVO\'s core capabilities and common entry points.
Accessibility service access is required for gestures, screen content and floating features.
Adjust themes, colors, display and behavior so the home page works your way.
Choose the trigger direction, area and recognition method to invoke actions from the screen edge.
Organize common actions, reorder them and tune their icons for one-tap access.
View selected content in a floating window and adjust its size, opacity and dwell behavior.
Use OCR to recognize screen text, with confirmation and feedback options for steadier selection.
Save screen snippets to Pin Pool so you can revisit, organize and clean up important content.
Choose the right apps and default behaviors for translation, search, image tools and sharing.
Manage search engines, result layouts, history and search shortcuts.
Export your configuration for backup, then import it after reinstalling or moving to a new device.
Use background stability, advanced settings and data maintenance to keep the app reliable.
